entities.summary: Gar Trinring Tsendro, also known as Lon Trinling, was a famous general of the Tibetan Empire. He was the second son of minister Gar Tongtsen Yülsung. In Chinese records, his name was given as Lùn Qīnlíng or Qǐzhèng.
